title: Valid Sudoku
description:
Determine if a `9 x 9` Sudoku `board` is valid. Only the filled cells need to be validated according to the following rules:

1. Each row must contain the digits `'1'`–`'9'` without repetition.
2. Each column must contain the digits `'1'`–`'9'` without repetition.
3. Each of the nine `3 x 3` sub-boxes of the grid must contain the digits `'1'`–`'9'` without repetition.

Empty cells are represented by the character `'.'`. Note that a partially filled Sudoku board can be valid without necessarily being solvable.
hints: You only need a single pass over all 81 cells — do not attempt to solve the board.
Track seen digits per row, per column, and per 3x3 box using three arrays of 9 bitmasks (or hash sets).
Cell (r, c) belongs to 3x3 sub-box index (r // 3) * 3 + (c // 3).

examples.explanation: No digit repeats in any row, column, or 3x3 sub-box, so the board is valid.
The digit '8' appears twice in column 0 and twice in the top-left 3x3 sub-box.
